Rank 14 - Fitness

Gym Membership and Trainer Commission

Gyms need membership renewal, attendance, trainer commission, package expiry, and payment reminders.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 8,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is reasonable where even a few retained members cover the fee.

7.5Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 8,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,800,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target gyms, fitness centers, martial arts schools, and ladies-only fitness studios in city and district areas.

Members forget renewal, owners cannot see active/inactive members, and trainer commission is messy.

Know who is active, who expired, and which trainer earned commission.

Validation signals

  • Fitness locations are growing in cities.
  • Membership renewal is recurring.
  • Trainer commission is owner-visible.
  • Reminders can recover missed payments.

MVP modules

  • Member profile
  • Package expiry
  • Attendance
  • Renewal reminder
  • Trainer commission
  • Due payment
  • Daily cash report

Do not build first

  • Do not build fitness content app first.
  • Do not add diet plans first.
  • Do not build consumer marketplace.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Low-tech reception staff.
  • Member privacy.
  • Custom packages.
Mitigations
  • Simple check-in.
  • Minimal data.
  • Configurable packages.
